description_en: Creates a callback for subscribing to channel messages
description_zh: 创建订阅房间消息的回调
kebab_example: aliyun live create-event-sub --app-id 9qb10000 --events ChannelEvent --callback-url http://0000.com/callback --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateEventSub

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application to subscribe to. You can view your application IDs by navigating to ApsaraVideo Live > Live+ > ApsaraVideo Real-time Communication > Application Management. If no application exists, create one by clicking [Create Application]
parameters.help_zh: 订阅的应用ID。通过访问 视频直播>直播+>实时音视频>应用管理 可以查看拥有的应用ID，没有时可以通过【创建应用】进行新建
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the channel to subscribe to. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848210.html operation to query the subscribed channel IDs.

If the Users.N parameter is not empty, this parameter is required.
If ChannelId is set to * or left empty, all channels are subscribed. Each AppId allows only one all-channel subscription.
Each AppId allows a maximum of 20 subscriptions at the same time
parameters.help_zh:
订阅的频道ID。您可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848210.html接口查询订阅的频道ID。

如果Users.N参数不为空，则此参数必填。
ChannelId为*或者不填，表示为全频道订阅，每个AppId只允许1个全频道订阅。
每个AppId最多同时允许创建20个订阅
parameters.name: channel_id

parameters.help_en:
The users whose messages you want to subscribe to. If this parameter is empty, all users in the channel (including streamers and viewers) are subscribed. Format:

```
Users.1=****
Users.2=****
......
```
parameters.help_zh:
订阅哪些用户的消息，参数为空表示订阅该房间全部用户（包含主播和观众）。格式如下所示：

```
Users.1=****
Users.2=****
......
```
parameters.name: users

parameters.help_en: The callback URL. For the callback content, see the callback content examples below
parameters.help_zh: 回调地址。回调内容请参见以下回调内容示例
parameters.name: callback_url

SubscribeId.description_en: The ID of the created subscription
